Yeztugo (lenacapavir) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-560212  
Guideline Name 
Yeztugo (lenacapavir)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
5/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Yeztugo  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Requested drug is being used for pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) to reduce the risk of 
sexually acquired HIV (human immunodeficiency virus)-1 infection  


--- PDF page 1971 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1971 
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient's weight is greater than or equal to 35 kg (kilograms)  
 
AND 
 
3 - BOTH of the following:  
• 
Provider attests that the patient has a negative HIV-1 test prior to the initiation of 
Yeztugo  
• 
Provider attests that the patient has been informed about the need for the required 
testing, adherence, and every 6-month injection dosing schedule with Yeztugo  
 
AND 
 
4 - ONE of the following:  
 
 4.1 Trial and failure, contraindication or intolerance to BOTH of the following:  
• 
emtricitabine-tenofovir (generic Truvada)  
• 
Descovy  
 
OR 
 
 4.2 Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) from provider documenting BOTH of 
the following:  
• 
Patient would benefit from long-acting injectable therapy over standard oral regimens  
• 
Patient would be adherent to testing and dosing schedule  
 
Product Name:Yeztugo  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  


--- PDF page 1972 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1972 
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Provider attests that patient is adherent to the testing appointments and scheduled 
injections of Yeztugo  
 
AND 
 
2 - BOTH of the following:  
• 
Patient has a negative HIV-1 test  
• 
Provider confirms that the patient will be tested for HIV-1 infection with each 
subsequent injection  
 
2 .  Revision History  
 
Date  
Notes  
3/30/2026  
Updated GPIs. Updated HIV testing requirement in both initial and re
auth
